title: アカデミックリーディング
subtitle: Academic Reading
educationalGoal: This workshop-style course aims to foster practical skills for general management. Students will apply much of what they have learned from their past three years of study, including analytical methods, marketing skills, and information technology, in simple exercises related to business cases.
advice: This is a course for senior students, providing them an opportunity to brush up on learned skills and prior knowledge by working exercises in workshop style. The small class size enables students to freely discuss issues and easily interact with one another. The detailed contents of the exercises will be decided after a discussion with students in the first class. The tentative course plan includes the following: 1) Reading articles written in English from journals and newspapers in order to explore current topics related to the global situation and various cutting-edge technologies. 2) Working on mini-exercises based on the concept of “design thinking.” 3) Completing data analysis exercises. Especially for element 1), students are strongly encouraged to participate in the “TOEIC(R) Challenge!” program offered by the KIT Essential English Center. Students are expected to actively commit to each and every class.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of management. Basic data analysis skills. Knowledge of basic English grammar and vocabulary. Basic computer skills.

activityGoals.body: Be able to gather information from articles written in English.
Be able to manage a project based on the procedures of design thinking.
Be able to properly conduct analysis procedures for business data.
Be able to develop a management plan in a simple business case.
